title: Flamingo reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bookL' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#f9e79f'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#f7dc6f'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bookR' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#f5b041'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#eb984e'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- legs -->
  <line x1='46' y1='78' x2='44' y2='94' stroke='#e8749a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='78' x2='58' y2='94' stroke='#e8749a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 94 h9 M54 94 h9' stroke='#c85a80' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='63' rx='19' ry='14' fill='#ff8fb1'/>
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='68' rx='14' ry='8' fill='#ffa8c4'/>

  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M44 55 C40 44 42 32 48 28' stroke='#ff8fb1' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M44 55 C40 44 42 32 48 28' stroke='#ffa8c4' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='26' r='8' fill='#ff8fb1'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='23' r='1.6' fill='#3b1a2a'/>
  <circle cx='56.5' cy='22.4' r='0.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M58 26 L66 29 L58 31 Z' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <path d='M58 30 L64 30.6' stroke='#3b1a2a' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- wings holding book -->
  <path d='M38 58 C33 58 31 62 33 66' stroke='#ff7096' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 58 C69 58 71 62 69 66' stroke='#ff7096' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- book -->
  <path d='M31 66 L50 62 L50 76 L31 80 Z' fill='url(#bookL)' stroke='#d4ac0d' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M69 66 L50 62 L50 76 L69 80 Z' fill='url(#bookR)' stroke='#ca6f1e' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='62' x2='50' y2='76' stroke='#b9770e' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- page lines -->
  <path d='M35 68 L46 65.5 M35 71.5 L46 69 M35 75 L46 72.5' stroke='#b9770e' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 65.5 L65 68 M54 69 L65 71.5 M54 72.5 L65 75' stroke='#a35a12' stroke-width='0.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
